acceptance: The cache trim runs at a cycle start, in a test with a fake trim
With 9% free the guard prints a WARN line and the dispatch goes on
With 4% free the guard pauses new dispatches, and with 6% free it resumes them
A failed free-space read prints a WARN line and does not pause
fix: Call the cache trim of evolve gc at the start of each cycle and of each console lane floor. Add a disk guard: at 10% free it prints a WARN line, and at 5% free it pauses new dispatches until space is free again. Use the looppreflight.DiskFreeBytes seam for tests.
notes: Owner in the plan: a Sonnet lane. The fix surface touches go/internal/core but no gate file. Admission decides; the narrowed protected fence lands soon.
